notes.title: Level Creator Update!
notes.notes:
Unleash Your Creativity 🌺

Introducing the Level Creator
[previewyoutube=u4NKIzKX9gk;full][/previewyoutube]

 Create Your Own Levels: The Level Creator is an in-game cross-platform tool that allows you to create and play your own levels. It’s integrated into the base game, so no additional software is needed.
 Upload and Download Levels: Once you’ve created and won a level, you can upload it for others to play. You can also browse and download levels created by other players, and even edit them to your liking.
 Community Interaction: Engage with the “We Are One” community on our Discord server. Share your creations, get feedback, and discover new levels from other players.
 Tailor your Challenges: With customizable settings, you have the power to decide the puzzles you want to create, the enemies you want to combat, and the duration of your level. Choose from different terrains and skyboxes like Forest, Clearing, and Factory to add an extra layer of personalization to your levels.
 Tutorial: If you’re new to the Level Editor, there’s a replayable and skippable tutorial to help you get started.

 So why wait? Dive in and start creating your own levels now!

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
Massive QoL change: You can now overwrite all spawnpoints.
Now you don't have to restart a level if you messed up an earlier clone.

You can overwrite each clone but overwriting an older clone will also overwrite all clones newer than the one you're overwriting.

notes.title: Ghost replay update!
notes.notes:
🔁 Ghost Replays are here! 🔁

Have you ever found yourself wondering how the top 10 players on the leaderboards achieved such incredible times? Well, wonder no more! Experience their epic moves and strategies first-hand as you watch these skilled replays. But that's not all - with ghost replays, you can also save and revisit your own gameplay moments locally,

Bug Fixes 🐜:

 Fixed an issue where player names on the leaderboards could be too long and obscuring the score
 Fixed an issue with bHaptics
